content: The execution was successful with a reward of 1.0. Key technical insights for HWPX manipulation include: 1) HWPX is a ZIP-based format where text resides in XML files within the 'Contents' directory. 2) Paragraph layout caching in `<hp:lineSegArray>` must be removed when text content is modified to prevent rendering artifacts (overlapping text) in Hancom Office. 3) Dynamic namespace detection is critical as the 'hp' prefix may vary, though the URI `urn:hancom:hwpx:1.0:hp` is standard. 4) Proper ZIP packaging requires the 'mimetype' file to be the first entry and uncompressed (ZIP_STORED) to comply with ODF-style standards.
